elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 states that “Each Party's aggregate liability” is subject to the cap.

elements.element: The cap's fee-based limb is fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly uses “fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the 12-month fee-based limb and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 sets the cap at “the greater of” the specified 12-month fees and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that, except for Excluded Claims, “neither Party is liable for indirect” damages.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that, except for Excluded Claims, “neither Party is liable for” consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of confidentiality in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data-protection obligations is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of data-protection obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of security obligations is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of security obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Gross negligence is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes gross negligence in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Wilful misconduct is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Fraud is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes fraud in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not treated as damages or limited by the liability cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due “is not damages and is not limited by this Section.”

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the aggregate liability cap to “Each Party.”

elements.element: The cap amount equals 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 instead sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000; when 12 months' fees are below USD 1,000,000, the cap does not equal 12 months' fees.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Gross negligence is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

elements.element: Wilful misconduct is carved out from the cap and uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is excepted from the cap by Section 21.1.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the preferred mutual greater-of cap, mutual damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment. The fallback is not independently satisfied because its 12-month-fees cap is replaced by a greater-of formulation with a USD 1,000,000 floor. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing liability structure, though using lowercase “fees” rather than the apparent defined term “Fees” is a minor drafting inconsistency.
